name: LibreCuts
hook: Open-source Android video editor with timeline editing and no heavy watermarks.
bullets: Real timeline editing with cuts, transitions and basic effects
No forced watermarks or locked premium exports
benefits: Real CapCut alternative without paywall traps
details: LibreCuts is an emerging open-source Android video editor providing timeline-based editing without watermarks, locked exports, or invasive tracking found in commercial apps like CapCut/KineMaster.
